name: Faultless: The Riders, Their Horses and the Pursuit of Excellence
original_name: Faultless: The Riders, Their Horses and the Pursuit of Excellence
overview: Top athletes from around the world arrive at Spruce Meadows for the 50th Anniversary Masters Tournament. Lillie Keenan and Kyle King are among the riders vying for the 34 remaining spots in Sunday's record-shattering five-million-dollar Grand Prix.
